intro.text: The Queen of Teod, King Eventeo's wife and Sarene's mother.

items.text: Her father was a Teo diplomat, so she grew up largely in JinDo, and its culture and customs left a deep mark on her. Ashe came to her by Passing. Her sharp mind was part of what attracted Eventeo, and the two married and had two children, Teorn and Sarene; at Sarene's birth, Ashe was Passed on to the baby.
Anxious for Sarene to be happy, she prayed for her often, asking above all that the marriage to Raoden would turn out well.

personality.text: A firm believer in JinDo ideas about healthy eating, she went through phases of fascination with odd dishes like Hraggish weed soup. Wanting Eventeo to be healthier and slimmer, she put him and the palace staff on a diet.
